capabilities:getById.reason: Public capability metadata supports anonymous discovery before login.

capabilities:getProviders.reason: Public capability routing metadata is needed by discovery clients; it contains no provider credentials.

capabilities:list.reason: Public capability catalog supports discovery before login.

capabilities:listByCategory.reason: Public capability categories support discovery before login.

cliAuth:start.reason: Login must start before a workspace session exists; this only creates a pending state and PKCE challenge.

deviceAuth:complete.reason: Retired compatibility endpoint always rejects and cannot link a device.

deviceAuth:poll.reason: Retired compatibility endpoint returns only retired status.

deviceAuth:start.reason: Retired compatibility endpoint returns login instructions without creating identity.

directCall:getActionById.reason: Public action definitions describe parameters and paths without provider credentials.

directCall:getActionByName.reason: Public action definitions describe parameters and paths without provider credentials.

directCall:getActions.reason: Public action definitions support catalog and client discovery without provider credentials.

directCall:getByApiSlug.reason: Public API discovery returns a redacted routing config without stored credentials.

directCall:getDirectCallConfig.reason: Public routing metadata uses redactedConfig to omit provider credentials.

directCall:getLiveConfigs.reason: Public live-provider discovery uses redactedConfig to omit provider credentials.

discoveryListings:published.reason: Public listing catalog returns only published, reviewed metadata.

funnel:recordEvent.reason: Pre-login install and diagnostic intake is public; canonical authentication and execution events are rejected.

managedRouting:getActionById.reason: Public action definitions describe parameters and paths without provider credentials.

managedRouting:getActionByName.reason: Public action definitions describe parameters and paths without provider credentials.

managedRouting:getActions.reason: Public action definitions support catalog and client discovery without provider credentials.

managedRouting:getByApiSlug.reason: Public API discovery returns a redacted routing config without stored credentials.

managedRouting:getDirectCallConfig.reason: Public routing metadata uses redactedConfig to omit provider credentials.

managedRouting:getLiveConfigs.reason: Public live-provider discovery uses redactedConfig to omit provider credentials.

mcpOAuth:getClientForAuthorize.reason: Pre-login consent UI validates the redirect URI and returns public client metadata without client secrets.

missions:discover.reason: Public mission capability discovery returns template metadata; mission execution remains internal.

missions:listTemplates.reason: Public mission template catalog contains no customer missions or workspace data.

pipelineAlign:searchDiscovery.reason: Public API catalog search exposes discovery metadata, not execution or credentials.

providerDiscovery:listForDiscovery.reason: Public discovery lists live managed API metadata without provider credentials.

providerHealth:getAllPublic.reason: Public provider health aggregates support status displays without workspace logs or identities.

providers:getApiById.reason: Public API details are restricted to providerAPIs IDs, preventing arbitrary document reads.

providers:getApprovedAPIs.reason: Public discovery lists approved API metadata.

providers:getCategories.reason: Public discovery category counts are computed from approved APIs.

providers:getProviderAPIs.reason: Public provider catalog contains API definitions without stored credentials.

providers:getProviderAPIsWithStatus.reason: Public provider catalog adds managed-routing availability without stored credentials.

publicApiHealth:snapshot.reason: Public callable status snapshot contains only API IDs and health-check time.

telemetry:track.reason: Pre-login CLI diagnostic intake is public and returns no stored telemetry or identity.

waitlist:count.reason: Public waitlist count supports the landing page without exposing email addresses.

waitlist:join.reason: Visitors must be able to submit a waitlist email before a workspace exists; stored entries are never listed publicly.
